title: The Hermit of the Gate
text: An old man sits beside the path with a lantern on his knee, as though he has been waiting for this party in particular. He knows your names. He knows the names of your dead. He will answer one question, he says, and only one, and he will not lie.

options.label: Ask him what waits at the end of the road, and trust that he keeps his word.

outcomes.text: He tells you how the master of this place fights. He has watched it for a long time, and you believe every word.
He answers truthfully, but the truth is worse than you feared. It weighs on your steps for the rest of the road.

options.label: Thank him, and go on. Some answers cost more than they are worth.

outcomes.text: He nods, as though that were the right answer, and touches the Leader's brow as they pass. Their head is clearer than it has been in days.

options.label: The Soothsayer asks him what the cards would not say, though they may regret hearing it.

outcomes.text: He answers in the Soothsayer's own voice, naming how high their House will stand when the reckoning comes.
His answer concerns the Soothsayer's own death. They refuse to repeat what he told them.
